notes.title: Wyrd Waters Dev Update – Demo is LIVE for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The Wyrd Waters [b]demo is now live[/b] on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest and we’re thrilled to finally let you all dive into the chaos of tactical fleet combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308555/19a83a86ffadc2c4d417d9f5b5292c363582b060.png"][/img][/p][p]If you miss the festival window, you still have a few extra days to check it out and bring some friends aboard. The demo will stay up until launch.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚨 Full Game Release Date: June 20[/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that Wyrd Waters will officially launch on June 20[/p][p]That’s just around the corner and we can’t wait to welcome you all back to the high seas.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💸 Wyrd Waters will be just $1.99[/b][/h3][p]No microtransactions and no hidden costs. Just $1.99 for the full game.[/p][p][b]Buy a few extra copies[/b] so your friends can join your fleet (or betray you horribly if they must).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Platform Compatibility[/b][/h3][p]We know a lot of you are asking about portable and cross-platform play. [/p][p]We recently posted an update on Steam Deck compatibility [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3001570/discussions/0/601905007519939200/"]here[/url]. We’re also happy to confirm that [b]Mac and Linux[/b] versions will be supported at launch.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for now![/p][p]Jump into the demo, share your feedback, and let us know what wild naval stories you’ve come away with.[/p][p]See you on the seas.[/p][p][i]— Maximalist ⚓[/i][/p]

notes.title: Wyrd Waters Dev Update – A New Dawn
notes.content:
[p]Welcome aboard the very first dev update for Wyrd Waters! Whether you’re an experienced captain or just joining the crew, we’re beyond excited to have you with us as we embark on this thrilling adventure together. Let’s dive in! 🚢⚓️

[i]Don’t worry, the Kraken won’t bite…🐙[/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308555/0dca9c2833e00e0f16c67348ccdf6e260c03daa6.gif"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]What is Wyrd Waters?
[/b][/h2][p]Set sail into the world of Wyrd Waters, a [b]multiplayer tactical fantasy naval gam[/b]e that draws inspiration from Anglo-Saxon myths and folklore! ⚓️🌊

[b]Gather your crew, craft your custom fleets, and outsmart your opponents[/b] in epic sea battles. But it’s not just about battling rivals—[b]resource management is key[/b] to staying afloat for future rounds! ⛵️

Watch out, though—the Kraken lurks in the depths, and the fog of war hides even more dangers. 🐙 
Are you ready to navigate these treacherous waters and prove you have the wits and skill to dominate the high seas?

[b]Strategic gameplay[/b] means every move matters. [b]Team up with friends[/b] or face off against foes—either way, victory requires clever tactics, sharp strategy, and a steady hand at the helm!🌟

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308555/98565e4faaed3b6b8d97a3e872ac5f50ac8baab4.gif"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]What Can You Expect in Future Updates?
[/b][/h2][p]As we craft and build our ships for the high seas, we’re bringing you [b] dev updates[/b] to keep you in the loop! [b]Expect sneak peeks of new ship designs, cool mechanics[/b], and all the progress we’re making as we chart this course together. 🌟

In our next update, get ready for an inside look at the ships, their unique powers, and what makes Wyrd Waters a game like no other. Stay tuned, the journey’s just getting started! ⚓️🔥

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308555/8ab0abd3a29e0c3fad60be3a5f235e2a92d209e6.gif"][/img]
Stay connected with us on [url="https://discord.gg/WsTahW3e9j"]Discord [/url]and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/maximalistltd.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url] for more updates and announcements — test your skills before the tides fully turn!  [i]— Maximalist [/i][/p]
